olivia: heads up — production errors for embeddings started after last night's KMS rotate. customers hitting 403 insufficient_scope on /v1/embeddings.

sam: can you paste the error and a sample request?

olivia: here's a curl we used: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_..." -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input": "test"}'``` response: `{"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"token missing embeddings scope"}` Also log id: eid=prod/emb/7890

maria-security: checking audit logs now. which key rotated? key tag `kms:wrapping:eu-prod-2` rotated at 2026-03-19T23:10:07Z

devops-bot: deploy 2026-03-19T23:08:12 by jenny merged: PR #4382 'per-route allowlist matching refactor'

jenny: that PR changed how per-route scope allowlists are matched — introduced wildcard precedence fallback (intended) but I might have missed an embeddings/chat overlap.

akash: my hunch: we tightened scope enforcement to require explicit `embeddings` scope for /v1/embeddings. Old tokens with composite tag `model:read` used to permit access. rotation reissued new tokens with only `chat` and `model:read` but not `embeddings`.

sam: can you run a quick repro using old token vs new token? I can also confirm in staging.

olivia: repro attached: old token (pre-rotate): success. new token: 403. snippet: ```HTTP/1.1 403
{"error":"insufficient_scope","required":"embeddings"}```

maria-security: audit trail shows token creation by service-account `embed-svc` at rotation, scope list in KMS metadata: `chat, model:read` — no embeddings. KMS wrapper rotation script dropped per-route scope tag when rewrapping.

jenny: ok — two mitigation paths: revert PR #4382 immediately or patch the rotation script. propose quick mitigation: allow fallback rule for `model:read` -> embeddings for 6 hours and rollback token issuance. runbook (short):
1) Set runtime flag to enable fallback: `REDWOOD_RBAC_FALLBACK=model_read_for_embeddings=true` to reduce user impact.
2) Re-wrap keys for embed-svc with correct `rbac_scope` metadata.
3) Backfill missing scope metadata on wrapped keys and reissue tokens where necessary.
4) Monitor 403 rates and notify CS/customers.

akash: I'll take #2, maria you own audit confirm. jenny please produce a small patch to tighten matching and include regression tests. sam please coordinate staged verification.

maria-security: started backfill to tag existing wrapped keys with missing `embeddings` scope. ETA ~25m. initial count: 12 customer tokens affected. creating incident ticket INC-2026-345 and linking logs.

olivia: ping if you need me to open pager. also need a postmortem template — I will own root cause and timeline.

devops-bot: rollback triggered for PR #4382 in prod at 2026-03-19T23:35:10Z by ops-oncall

jenny: rolled back in prod — monitoring now. please paste any remaining 403s here.

sam: staging repro ok with rollback. production 403s dropped to 0 in last 5m.

maria-security: audit finished, created timeline and evidence. root cause: KMS rotation script dropped `rbac_scope` metadata when wrapping keys; combined with PR #4382's tighter per-route match caused denial. hotfix PR #4410 inbound for the rotation script and metadata preservation.

olivia: thanks team. postmortem owner: olivia. next steps: publish PM, update KMS rotate playbook to preserve RBAC tags, add regression tests for per-route scope mapping, and add a check in CI that simulates key rewrap.

olivia: :white_check_mark:
